messages:
Maya: Heads-up — received a customer request this morning to surface per-customer cost and tie it to tracing spans so platform teams can debug expensive tails. They want a dashboard + lightweight tracing hooks.
Liam: Can you paste the exact ask? are they looking for model-level split or route-level?
Maya: Model + route + API key. Example: show cost per model variant for /v1/chat and link to traces showing where the tokens were charged. Prefer low-effort instrumentation.
Priya: Short answer: we can add span tags: `model_variant`, `route`, `api_key_hash`, and emit a `cost_estimate` field on the root span. That lets dashboards aggregate by those dims.
Noah: Sampling concerns — if we only sample 1% of traces we lose tail visibility for expensive customers. Suggest default sample=1% but sampling=100% when cost_estimate > X or during canary windows.
Dina: For acceptance criteria, what do we need for GA? My proposal: 1) Dashboard showing top N customers by cost (model+route) over 7d, 2) traces linked from dashboard to full trace view, 3) error-slice panel (errors by model+route), 4) doc with rollout plan and SDK snippet.
Maya: Sounds good. Customer also asked for cost-attribution to be queryable in console and exported to BigQuery for billing.
Priya: Export path is doable via the telemetry pipeline — tag the events and dump to export topic. Need to agree on schema. Keep it minimal: `timestamp, api_key_hash, model_variant, route, tokens, cost_estimate, trace_id`.
Liam: Who owns the schema? I can take ownership if infra supports the export contract.
Noah: One caveat: `cost_estimate` on span is approximate at request time; actual billing may differ after batching/aggregation. We should label it clearly in UI.
Dina: UI requirements: allow customer filter, time range, and pivot by model/route; and a per-request drilldown that opens trace details and highlights the cost-influencing spans.
Maya: UX ask: show a mini-summary line with `est_cost`, `p99_latency`, `error_rate` for the selected customer.
Priya: Implementation notes for SDKs: add optional param `observability_tags: { model_variant, route }` and push `span.set_tag('cost_estimate', float)` when we compute tokens. Example snippet:
```
span.set_tag('model_variant', 'redwood-v2-q4')
span.set_tag('route', '/v1/chat')
span.set_tag('cost_estimate', 0.0123)
```
Maya: Great. Can we quantify effort? Priya, Noah, estimate work and blockers.
Priya: Backend: ~2w (collection + export schema + storage changes). UI: ~1.5w for dashboard MVP. SDKs: small patches across languages ~3-4d each.
Noah: Infra: tracing ingestion needs a tiny bump for additional tags and optional high-sample path — ~1w. We'll need an SLO for trace retention costs.
Liam: Risk: privacy — storing `api_key_hash` is ok but ensure we don't surface raw keys. Also need legal sign-off for exported telemetry.
Dina: I'll schedule a short legal review. Also, set launch guardrails: disable export by default, export only on opt-in for enterprise customers.
Maya: Rollout plan: 1) Prototype internal dashboard for 2 customers (canary) with sampling=100% for them, 2) iterate with feedback, 3) GA with export opt-in.
Priya: Quick wins: add `model_variant` tag and `route` today (hotfix window), then follow with cost_estimate and export.
Noah: Metrics to validate: correlation between estimated cost and actual billing > 85% for top-20 customers, p99 tail coverage for canary customers, dashboard load under 200ms for common queries.
Dina: Who will own launch checklist? Maya + Liam + Ops + Legal. I'll make a doc and checklist after this thread.
Maya: OK assigning: Liam = export schema owner, Priya = SDK + collection owner, Noah = tracing ingestion + sampling, Dina = launch checklist + legal coordination. I'll follow up with a short meeting invite.
Liam: +1. Also propose feature flag gating and metrics in console to show adoption.
Priya: One more: annotate traces with `billing_window_id` to support grouping when batching changes cost attribution.
Maya: Thanks all — next steps captured. :thumbsup:
observability-bot: New action created: `OBS-612` "Cost attribution dashboard + span tagging" assigned to Maya, Priya, Liam, Noah, Dina.
